newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks mixed in London, GM up $1/8.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mixed in London, GM up $1/8.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mixed in London, and brokers here said Wall Street may see another day of profit-taking.
"There isn't much interest here," said one. "The market feels weak."
In otherwise light and quiet trading, shares in General Motors edged up $1/8 to $54-3/4 after the automaker reached a tentative agreement on Tuesday with Canadian autoworkers.
Shares in Ford Motor were marked up $1/8 to $31-5/8, while Chrylser Corp shares were unchanged at $33-5/8.
Shares in Digital Equipment rose $1/4 to$29-1/4 on bargain hunting after yesterday's $5-3/8-plunge.
The shares fell to their lowest level since October 1994 in New York yesterday after Digital reported a wider-than-expected loss for its fiscal first quarter.
Shares in Intel Corp were off $1/4 in London to $105-1/4, adding to the $2-1/4 loss posted in New York trading. But shares in Texas Instruments were up $1/8 to $51-5/8 in London.
On Globex, the December S&P 500 futures contract was up 0.30 points to 709.30 by 1035 GMT. The December 30-year Treasury bond futures contract was up 2/32 at 110-22/32.
